attributes.board_name: Utah Division of Professional Licensing (DOPL), Board of Nursing

rules.alternatives: No general CE hours: an APRN must be currently certified or recertified in the specialty area (APRNs licensed before July 1, 1992: 30 hours of approved CE plus 400 hours of practice). The 3.5 hours apply only to controlled substance prescribers.
rules.audit_note: Keep documentation of the controlled substance CE for 2 years after the end of the renewal cycle (R156-37-402).

topics.who: Controlled substance prescribers (Schedule II/III opioids, hypnotics or psychostimulants): prescribing class with post-course assessment covering the FDA opioid REMS blueprint, Utah resources, documentation, office policies and medical cannabis
Controlled substance prescribers, licensing periods starting after Jan 1, 2024: one-time SBIRT training class; it also counts as the 3.5 controlled substance hours for that period

rules.notes: APRN licenses renew on a 2-year cycle. The statute text read was the 5/3/2023 version marked 'Renumbered 5/6/2026' (new section number not checked). dopl.utah.gov renewal pages were behind a Cloudflare check and were not read.
rules.legal_basis: Utah Admin. Code R156-31b-303(3)(b); R156-37-402; Utah Code 58-37-6.5
